templates.name: Nonprofit Grant Campaign
templates.description: Coordinate grant research, narrative drafts, budget package, board review, submission, and follow-up reporting.

tasks.title: Research grant fit
tasks.description: Confirm eligibility, program fit, deadlines, and submission requirements.

tasks.title: Draft grant narrative
tasks.description: Write need, program design, impact model, and implementation plan.

tasks.title: Prepare grant budget
tasks.description: Build budget, match notes, staff allocations, and finance assumptions.

tasks.title: Submit grant package
tasks.description: Finalize forms, attachments, signatures, and submission receipt.

milestones.title: Grant package drafted
milestones.description: Narrative and budget are ready for review.

milestones.title: Grant submitted
milestones.description: Application package is submitted and receipt is saved.

docs.title: Grant Narrative Outline
docs.body: Need, program model, implementation, impact measures, and sustainability.

docs.title: Grant Budget Notes
docs.body: Budget assumptions, match, staff allocations, restricted funds, and reporting requirements.

intakeForm.title: Grant Opportunity Intake
intakeForm.description: Capture grant opportunities, eligibility notes, and submission deadlines.

templates.name: Agency Retainer OS
templates.description: A paid-style operating system for retainers: client health, monthly planning, approvals, scope control, billing notes, and renewal prep.

tasks.title: Score client health
tasks.description: Review delivery confidence, open risks, relationship strength, and renewal signals.

tasks.title: Plan monthly outcomes
tasks.description: Turn client goals into a scoped monthly plan with owners and acceptance criteria.

tasks.title: Review scope and change requests
tasks.description: Compare requested work to retainer scope and prepare change-order recommendations.

tasks.title: Collect client approvals
tasks.description: Package deliverables, decision notes, and approval requests for the client portal.

tasks.title: Prepare billing and renewal notes
tasks.description: Capture billable context, expansion ideas, renewal risks, and next-month commitments.

milestones.title: Retainer review complete
milestones.description: Billing, renewal, and next-month notes are ready.

docs.title: Client Health Scorecard
docs.body: Delivery health, relationship health, risks, opportunities, renewal signal, and owner notes.

docs.title: Retainer Scope Log
docs.body: Included work, out-of-scope requests, change-order notes, approvals, and billing context.

intakeForm.title: Retainer Request Intake
intakeForm.description: Capture client requests, urgency, scope fit, and approval needs.
